name: Access control: whose data
about: Who may read or change a record: owner and tenant checks, ids taken from the request instead of the login.

name: Authentication: who is calling
about: How the caller is identified: tokens, sessions, password and reset flows, and what happens without a valid login.

name: Personal data: what is exposed
about: Personal details in responses, logs, exports and error messages, and who can see them.

name: Money and rounding
about: Amounts and currencies: decimals against floats, rounding rules, totals, tax and refunds.

name: Idempotency and retries
about: The same request or event arriving twice: duplicate charges or records, retries, idempotency keys, webhooks.

name: Query safety: injection
about: Queries and commands built from input: SQL, shell, templates and paths, and how parameters are bound.

name: Secrets and configuration
about: Keys, tokens and settings: where they live, unsafe defaults, what gets logged, behaviour per environment.

name: Input validation
about: What the code accepts from outside: types, ranges, formats and sizes, and what it does with bad input.

name: Concurrency and races
about: Two requests at once: check-then-act, lost updates, counters, locks and unique constraints.

name: Transactions and data integrity
about: Writes that must succeed or fail together: partial failure, rollbacks, constraints and cascades.

name: State transitions
about: Which status may follow which, for orders, invoices or subscriptions, and transitions that must be refused.

name: API compatibility
about: Changes that callers depend on: response shapes, renamed fields, status codes, defaults and versions.

name: Error handling
about: What happens when something fails: status codes, swallowed exceptions, fallbacks, messages that leak internals.

name: Empty and missing values
about: None, zero, empty strings and lists, missing keys and optional fields, and what the code does with them.

name: Time and time zones
about: Dates and times: time zones, daylight saving, expiry, deadlines and boundaries such as end of month.

name: Pagination and limits
about: How much comes back: page size, cursors and offsets, unbounded queries, off-by-one at the edges.

name: Caching and invalidation
about: What is cached, under which key and for whom, and when it goes stale or reaches the wrong user.

name: Performance: queries and complexity
about: N+1 queries, loops over large data, missing indexes, and work repeated on every request.

name: Other
about: A decision none of the above covers.
